factorial.description: Write a function `factorial(n)` that returns the factorial of a non-negative integer n.
factorial.test_code:
assert factorial(0) == 1
assert factorial(1) == 1
assert factorial(5) == 120
assert factorial(10) == 3628800

fibonacci.description: Write a function `fibonacci(n)` that returns the nth Fibonacci number (0-indexed, so fibonacci(0)=0, fibonacci(1)=1).
fibonacci.test_code:
assert fibonacci(0) == 0
assert fibonacci(1) == 1
assert fibonacci(10) == 55
assert fibonacci(15) == 610

fizzbuzz.description: Write a function `fizzbuzz(n)` that returns 'FizzBuzz' if n is divisible by both 3 and 5, 'Fizz' if divisible by 3 only, 'Buzz' if divisible by 5 only, otherwise the string representation of n.
fizzbuzz.test_code:
assert fizzbuzz(15) == "FizzBuzz"
assert fizzbuzz(9) == "Fizz"
assert fizzbuzz(10) == "Buzz"
assert fizzbuzz(7) == "7"
assert fizzbuzz(30) == "FizzBuzz"

gcd.description: Write a function `gcd(a, b)` that returns the greatest common divisor of two positive integers a and b.
gcd.test_code:
assert gcd(12, 8) == 4
assert gcd(17, 13) == 1
assert gcd(100, 25) == 25
assert gcd(7, 7) == 7

is_palindrome.description: Write a function `is_palindrome(s)` that returns True if string s is a palindrome (ignoring case), False otherwise.
is_palindrome.test_code:
assert is_palindrome("racecar") == True
assert is_palindrome("RaceCar") == True
assert is_palindrome("hello") == False
assert is_palindrome("A") == True
assert is_palindrome("") == True

reverse_words.description: Write a function `reverse_words(s)` that reverses the order of words in a string s. Words are separated by spaces.
reverse_words.test_code:
assert reverse_words("hello world") == "world hello"
assert reverse_words("a b c") == "c b a"
assert reverse_words("single") == "single"
assert reverse_words("") == ""
